services.name: whale watching safari
services.desc: Some of the best whale watching in Iceland takes place near the Old Harbor of Reykjavik, the country’s capital. Since most travelers will either pass through Reykjavik or use it as their home base for visiting Iceland, this makes whale watching an easy activity to incorporate into any itinerary. During my two week road trip across Iceland’s southern coast, I was mostly set on exploring glaciers, chasing waterfalls and checking out the beautiful black sand beaches found in this region.
